headline: A 2018 law directs Congress's leaders to arrange a Congressional Gold Medal to honor Larry Doby, the baseball player and civil rights figure.
what_it_does: The law tells the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for a Congressional Gold Medal to be presented to Larry Doby. The medal recognizes his achievements in major league baseball, his contributions to civil rights, and his service in the Armed Forces during World War II. The summary does not describe any money, rules, or services beyond this honor.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 17, 2018.
